items.item_text: Valid California RN license without restrictions
Bachelor's Degree in Nursing
Master's Degree in Nursing
Multiple years of recent experience in acute care and/or ICU/inpatient medical-surgical nursing. Clinical chart review and abstraction experience.
Advanced clinical knowledge with >5 years’ experience in hospital-based patient care.
Experience presenting quality-related data to physicians, department chairs, and hospital leadership.

The Quality Improvement Nurse: Transfusion Safety Officer (TSO) serves as a patient safety advocate and quality leader responsible for managing the organization’s Patient Blood Management (PBM) Program to ensure that all transfusion-related activities are designed to ensure patient safety, comply with all Hospital Policies and Procedures, and meet or exceed CDPH, Joint Commission, FDA, AABB, and other accreditation and regulatory agency's.
Proficiency in applying performance improvement methodologies for retrospective and concurrent clinical reviews.
Quality Improvement work including chart review, performance improvement activities, analysis of data, presentation of education to various stakeholders
Intermediate to advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access) and familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
Demonstrated effective listening and questioning techniques.
Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams
Possess outstanding written and oral communication skills including the ability to lead discussions and deliver group presentations and prepare concise reports and action memos.
Ability to analyze data and present clear, actionable recommendations to various stakeholders and leadership audiences.
Knowledge of quality assurance, quality system essentials, quality improvement, benchmarking, metrics, data analysis, and audit processes.
Ability to recognize aberrant processes that could lead to failures.
Possess excellent strategic thinking, problem solving and decision making skills.
Possess the ability to establish and maintain cooperative relationships and to collaborate on interdepartmental projects.
Excellent project management skills with proven ability to effectively perform and timely manage quality improvement projects.
Ability to collect data using Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), EPIC EMR, RL Solutions.
Ability to produce high quality deliverables within established timelines.
Ability to recognize the need to keep confidential information secure, while exercising judgment, tact and discretion in handling sensitive or confidential information or situations.
Ability to demonstrate consistent level of high performance.
Possess technical knowledge of Transfusion Services Laboratory testing and processes OR Possess technical knowledge of Clinical Infusion Practices and processes.
Knowledge of state, federal, hospital and departmental regulations and requirements.
Knowledge of regulatory requirements pertaining to the Transfusion Services.
